title: [Restaurant P0] Foundation: Rename to restaurant words: Business, Outlet, Checklist
description:
WHAT

BEHAVIOUR
- Driven by organizations.industry = 'restaurant'; other industries keep current words
- Home tabs: 'Due Tasks' and 'From Checklists'; cards show 'Outlet : <name>', 'Checklist : <name>', 'Task : <name>'
- Hide sprints, story points, time tracking, custom fields, saved board views, API keys, webhooks and SSO for restaurants

BACKEND / DB
Add organizations.industry varchar(30). Update platform_settings.platform_name to OpsPick. String table for UI labels keyed by industry.

DONE WHEN
- A restaurant account never shows the words Workspace, Project, Planner or Mini Task Manager
- Non-restaurant accounts look exactly as today

Demo: OpsPick Restaurant Demo (Claude artifact). View as Owner -> Home.
Screenshot attached shows the target screen in the current app style.

BEHAVIOUR
- OTP valid 5 minutes, resend after 30 s, max 5 tries per hour per number

- Security / change password screen hidden for phone-only users

BACKEND / DB
Reuse users.phone and otp_codes. Rate limit OTP endpoint. SMS provider with DLT-registered sender and template.

DONE WHEN
- Staff can log in with only a mobile number
- Wrong OTP shows a clear error and remaining tries

Demo: OpsPick Restaurant Demo (Claude artifact). Settings -> Sign out shows the login screen.
Screenshot attached shows the target screen in the current app style.
